description: The Municipality of Lecce publishes georeferenced public-lighting poles and control cabinets, described as updated to 2014. Two Shapefile distributions separate the poles from the cabinets. The native metadata specifies WGS 84 / UTM zone 33N, EPSG:32633. These physical asset locations can support public-lighting infrastructure inventories and capacity-planning inputs. They do not establish electrical connections between each pole and cabinet, lamp technology, equipment condition or actual availability. The catalogue was edited after the stated asset year, which does not prove that the observations were refreshed. Public access is free under Creative Commons Attribution; the licence version is unspecified. The metadata API is reachable, while the browser landing route returned HTTP 429 during verification and remains unverified. Related Lecce electricity-consumption records describe demand at different dates; no source-established asset-level join between those totals and this inventory is available.
